learned_patterns.name: Live-org round trip is the acceptance evidence for CRM work
learned_patterns.context: Any change that reaches Dynamics or Dataverse
learned_patterns.pattern: Create a real record, read it back through the exact path the runtime uses, assert on that output, then delete the record. Unit and integration suites are necessary but never sufficient — the cache path, the security stripper, the deployed bundle and the live-metadata path all diverge.

learned_patterns.name: Test the sentinel, not just the happy value
learned_patterns.context: Contracts that document a special value (version 0 = latest, blank caller = service account)
learned_patterns.pattern: Every documented sentinel gets its own test. Two production-blocking defects came from sentinels that were treated as convention rather than contract.

common_mistakes.mistake: Verifying a web-resource change without a hard refresh
common_mistakes.symptom: Test reports the old behaviour and the fix is wrongly rejected
common_mistakes.prevention: Ctrl+F5 is a required step in any script that verifies a republished bundle.

common_mistakes.mistake: Testing a plugin fix on the first invocation after deployment
common_mistakes.symptom: The sandbox serves the previous AppDomain, so the first result is always stale
common_mistakes.prevention: Re-run once before recording a result.

common_mistakes.mistake: Driving browser verification by screen coordinates
common_mistakes.symptom: Clicks drift onto the wrong element; refs go stale after a tab switch; screenshots time out
common_mistakes.prevention: Click by element ref, re-read the page after any tab switch, and prefer get_page_text over screenshots on slow pages.

preferred_approaches.approach: Happy path, validation failure, and auth failure at minimum — per .claude/rules/common.md.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Auth failure is the case most often skipped and the one that matters most to the auditor.

preferred_approaches.approach: Number it, state the failing input and the observed output, and record it in the phase-5 document so the CEO can gate on it by ID.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Numbered defects flow into approve-with-conditions blockers in projects/state.yml.
